hints.title: Contiguous Vowel Order
hints.text: A valid vowel sequence must never decrease in alphabetical rank and must contain all five vowels.

hints.title: Track Distinct Vowel Steps
hints.text: Maintain running sequence length and count how many times characters strictly step upward in vowel order.

hints.title: Sequence Reset on Decrease
hints.text: When a character is strictly smaller than its predecessor, reset tracking and restart only if starting with a.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings takes quadratic time, leading to time limit exceeded on strings of length 500000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan tracking current run length and vowel transitions runs in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles reset conditions cleanly when adjacent characters are out of order.
